Collective Interface

Publication, Print, Website2024
Get your pamphlet here.

This pamphlet is weaving two texts, "Post-Internet City: Impressions of Disaster" by Nashin Mahtani and "Brand States: Postmodern Power, Democratic Pluralism, and Design" by Metahaven. The phone acts an interruptor but also an extension, referring to Nashin Mahtani's text, which employs people instead of the state during a disaster. The publication can be easily accessed by downloading the PDF on the website.
